functions.name: central_function
functions.description: Estimation of DNAm age per cohort (pooled across nodes)

databases.name: Beta/M values
databases.description: Dataframe of the IDAT extraction (Beta values per probe and sample)

arguments.name: clock_set
arguments.description: Which clocks to calculate. The sets are taken from the clocks in the image and leave out clocks needing inputs this algorithm does not provide. Clocks named below are added; choose 'Only the clocks listed below' to calculate just those. What each clock predicts: docs/clocks.md.

arguments.name: lista_relojes
arguments.description: Optional: clocks to add by name, e.g. horvath2013 (see docs/clocks.md for the 142 clocks). Delete the empty row if you only use a clock set.

arguments.name: cohort_column
arguments.description: Name of the column in each node's data that holds the cohort of each sample. Results are computed per cohort.

arguments.name: min_samples
arguments.description: Minimum number of samples a cohort needs on a node to be included in that node's result (at least 2). Cohorts below this threshold are dropped on the node.

arguments.name: coverage_threshold
arguments.description: Minimum coverage (share of a clock's CpGs present in a node's data, 0-1) for a result to be flagged coverage_ok. EPIC v2 lacks some clock CpGs and pyaging fills them with reference values or 0, which can bias the age. It only sets the flag; no clock or result is removed.

arguments.name: age_column
arguments.description: Column with the chronological age of each sample (e.g. 'age' from the IDAT extraction). Used to report the age acceleration, predicted minus chronological age; leave empty to skip.

arguments.name: organizations_to_include
arguments.description: Hospitals (organizations) to use; empty = all of the collaboration

ui_visualizations.name: Epigenetic age per cohort
ui_visualizations.description: Mean predicted age, chronological age and age acceleration per clock and cohort

ui_visualizations.name: Clock coverage
ui_visualizations.description: Share of each clock's CpGs present in the data
